sections.name: AuthLayout
sections.title: Sign-in screen stack
sections.what: Shows the onboarding and login screens in a stack with headers hidden and a fade transition.
sections.why: Gives signed-out users a simple, consistent flow with the app's own design.
sections.watch_out: Renaming a screen file means updating its name here too.

summary: Sets up the mobile sign-in area as a simple stack of screens with fading transitions and no header bar.
purpose: Groups the onboarding and login screens together so they move between each other as one section of the app.
why: The header is hidden because the screens draw their own design. The fade animation is a choice made here, with the reason not stated in the code.
how: Creates a stack navigator with no headers and a fade animation, then lists the onboarding and login screens in it.
inputs: The screens in the auth folder.
outputs: The navigation stack for signed-out users.
risks: Screens not listed here can still be reached by address. The register screen is not listed because it is part of the login screen.
debug: If a sign-in screen does not show, check that the file name matches the list. If the header appears unexpectedly, check the screen options.
